'''Daria Kellner''' was a tall, thin [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]]. She was an associate of [[Thadius Black]] on [[Demophon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], where she helped smuggle political prisoners away from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="I" />
